scenes.text: A man sits alone in a dimly lit room, staring at his phone while rain hits the window.
Your brain is overwhelmed by notifications, comparisons, and constant noise.
Crowds rush past him in a blurry street, but he feels completely invisible.
This is what anxiety feels like — too many thoughts, not enough clarity.
He stands on a rooftop at night, watching the city lights, searching for peace.
Your mind doesn’t need more information — it needs stillness.
Rain falls as he walks alone down a foggy street.
Slow down. Breathe. You are not broken.
